name: @infinitum/cid
description: Cumulus://ID (CID): one Infinitum account for every product. Passkeys, security keys, MFA, session revocation, app-by-app permissions recorded on Firmament, and organization SSO.

scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types $(find src -name "*.test.ts" 2>/dev/null || true) && CID_TEST_COPYING_REPO=1 node --test --experimental-strip-types src/cid.test.ts src/social.test.ts && if [ -n "$CID_TEST_PG_URL" ]; then CID_TEST_PG=1 node --test --experimental-strip-types src/cid.test.ts src/social.test.ts src/postgres.test.ts; fi
